Karthik / Monica — I reviewed GreenBridge's redlines and left inline comments in the attached Word. High-level notes below:

- Acceptable: Most DPA edits are clarifying; we can accept Processor role language but need to preserve our standard liability carve-outs and operational SLO references.
- Subprocessors: we can provide attestations for core infra subs within 3 business days. For managed ML tool partners we need partner confirmation (I flagged two in comments).
- Export controls / transfer impact: GreenBridge added a requirement for annual TIA updates and bespoke contractual guarantees. We should offer: annual TIA plus 30-day notice for material changes and an optional TIA addendum for EU legal teams to sign.
- Order form: redlines included a change to invoice timing and a new 60-day termination-for-convenience right. Recommend pushing back to 90 days and preserving committed capacity terms in Dedicated offer.

Action items (owners):
- Laura: produce redline response matrix and short memo explaining changes that we cannot accept (deliver by EOD Thu Aug 12).
- Monica: collate evidence pack (region maps, SOC2 excerpt, subprocessor attestations) and upload to shared Drive link by Fri Aug 13.
- Karthik: draft SCC fallback language + TIA addendum for external review by Mon Aug 16.

Attachments: Laura_GB_DPA_Comments_v1.docx
